Title: Investigate and remediate checkout startup failures on gitops-pilot-20260915-163116

Complete result:

## What's wrong
The `checkout` workload in namespace `payments` on cluster [gitops-pilot-20260915-163116](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/clusters/details/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260915-163116/details?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) was stuck at 2/4 replicas because new pod creation was blocked by a namespace `ResourceQuota` violation (`FailedCreate` / `exceeded quota: payments-quota`).

## Why
- Following the morning build update, the `checkout` deployment requested 4 replicas with `256Mi` memory requests each (`1024Mi` total).
- Co-located `pricer` deployment in `payments` namespace runs 2 replicas with `64Mi` memory requests each (`128Mi` total), bringing required total namespace memory requests to `1152Mi`.
- The `payments-quota` `ResourceQuota` had `spec.hard.requests.memory` configured at `832Mi`. After 2 `checkout` pods (`512Mi`) and 2 `pricer` pods (`128Mi`) were scheduled (`640Mi` used), attempting to create the 3rd `checkout` pod requested `256Mi` (total `896Mi`), which exceeded the `832Mi` ceiling.

## What to do
- **Remediation submitted and merged:** Opened GitOps Pull Request [PR #31](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/pull/31) against branch `run/gitops-pilot-20260915-163116/b-0011` updating `payments-quota` `spec.hard.requests.memory` to `1152Mi` in `tasks/b-0011/00-gating.yaml`.
- **GitOps sync verified:** Argo CD application `b-0011` synced revision `77503c42d954f602338cf695591d859b06cb77df` and applied the updated `ResourceQuota` (`1152Mi`) to cluster [gitops-pilot-20260915-163116](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/clusters/details/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260915-163116/details?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos).

## Sources
- GKE Cluster & Workload APIs (`mcp__gke__get_k8s_resource`, `mcp__gke__list_clusters`)
- Developer Knowledge MCP (`mcp__developer_knowledge__answer_query`)
- GitOps repository: [gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra)
